column3: Upon the 535 & 545 5th Avenue Whole Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the WFCM 2026-5C8 PSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly respect to such Whole Loan accruing at a rate equal to 0.25% per annum, subject to a monthly minimum fee of $5,000.
